opinions.rationale: The valid core is narrower than the statement. Reporting a proportion mediated from hazard or subdistribution-hazard ratios does not generally yield a fraction of a counterfactual risk effect, and applying point-treatment mediation software after clone-censor weighting does not generally identify a longitudinal mediated effect. The sharp-null criticism of randomized interventional indirect effects is also valid. However, fixed longitudinal exposure histories are static sustained strategies, and existing mediational g-formula work already defines direct and indirect effects and gives longitudinal identification results under sequential exchangeability and positivity. Cloning and artificial censoring are estimation devices, not new interventions or populations. Conditioning an artificial-censoring model on mediator history measured before censoring can correct selection; it does not itself condition the causal contrast on that mediator. When the mediator also determines a dynamic treatment rule, the intervention ordering and path-specific estimand require explicit definition, but this is not proof that no mediated estimand exists. Repeated participation in sequential trials primarily changes the target distribution, dependence structure, and variance calculation, not whether mediation counterfactuals can be defined. Likewise, an eighth universal protocol component is unnecessary because mediator interventions, measurement times, causal contrasts, intercurrent-event handling, and analysis can be prespecified within the existing strategy and analysis-plan components. The assertion that treatment-induced mediator-outcome confounding makes cross-world independence fail outright is too strong: it generally defeats standard nonparametric identification rather than logically forcing every possible cross-world restriction to be false. A genuine gap remains for defensible implementation when grace-period or dynamic strategies interact with the mediator, mediator visits are informative, and clone-censor and mediator-process weights must be combined. That is a specialized extension and reporting problem, not a missing foundation for all sustained strategies. It is critical only when mechanism is a decision-grade objective; it does not invalidate an otherwise valid total-effect emulation. No named package capability is asserted here, so no package claim was adjudicated.
opinions.weakest_true_restatement: For mediation of a longitudinal treatment strategy, investigators must prespecify the mediator intervention or path-specific contrast, measurement and observation processes, temporal ordering, intercurrent-event handling, and assumptions for treatment, mediator and censoring processes. Existing mediational g-formula methods define and identify effects for fixed longitudinal exposure histories under strong assumptions, but a naive point-treatment mediation analysis of a clone-censor-weighted cohort, especially with informative mediator visits or a mediator that governs treatment deviation, need not identify that effect. Hazard-scale proportions mediated should not be interpreted as fractions of counterfactual risk effects.

resolving_work.title: Causal Mediation Analysis with Multiple Time-varying Mediators
resolving_work.what_it_resolves: Defines direct and indirect effects for longitudinal exposure histories and supplies nonparametric identification results. Static sustained regimes are included in that class, although clone-specific estimation and informative observation remain unresolved.
resolving_work.quote: In longitudinal studies with time-varying exposures and mediators, the mediational g-formula is an important method for the assessment of direct and indirect effects.

resolving_work.title: Mediation effects that emulate a target randomised trial: Simulation-based evaluation of ill-defined interventions on multiple mediators
resolving_work.what_it_resolves: Shows that mediator interventions and mediation contrasts can be specified explicitly as a target trial and estimated by g-computation, contradicting the claim that the standard seven-component template forces mediation to be appended post hoc.
resolving_work.quote: defining mediation effects that map to a target trial of hypothetical interventions targeting multiple mediators
